rows.description: A young adult recovers quickly from setbacks and rarely spirals over criticism. Calm is helpful, but may underestimate how much others are struggling, so asking rather than assuming matters.

rows.description: A partner is asked again and again for reassurance about small things and starts to feel drained. Offers care, but also gently encourages the person to build their own calming routines rather than feeling responsible for all their worry.
